in_arabic.name: Houshiar
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Wise, Intelligent, Learned
in_arabic.long_meaning: Houshiar هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Someone who is wise, intelligent, and learned. Derived from the Persian word 'housh' meaning wisdom and 'iar' meaning leader or ruler.

in_urdu.name: Houshiar
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Wise, Intelligent, Learned
in_urdu.long_meaning: Houshiar ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Someone who is wise, intelligent, and learned. Derived from the Persian word 'housh' meaning wisdom and 'iar' meaning leader or ruler.

in_hindi.name: Houshiar
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise, Intelligent, Learned
in_hindi.long_meaning: Houshiar एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who is wise, intelligent, and learned. Derived from the Persian word 'housh' meaning wisdom and 'iar' meaning leader or ruler.
